messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.d: Complete the Last Ember line by returning from the End with proof that the village can survive hearing about the dragon.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bottle the dragon's breath while the roar still sounds. Then come home with stone and a story that still belongs to you.
The Last Ember ends beyond the gate, but the village's part does not.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: The Last Ember notes end at a place I cannot make sound harmless.
If you go through the gate, bottle the dragon's breath while it still falls, end the roar, and return with proof that the silence belongs to the living.
There is no gentle wording for this stage. Bottle the dragon's breath while it still falls, face the dragon, and come back alive enough to argue about the notes.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bring 1 dragon breath as proof of the roar.
Bottle 1 dragon breath while the dragon is alive, then defeat the Ender Dragon.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Good. The End has waited longer than any of us. It can wait until you choose.
Return with your story still yours.
Bottle 1 dragon breath while the Ender Dragon is alive, defeat it, then bring 16 end stone back to the village.
The dragon answer is not open right now.
The Last Ember has already been carried home.
Bottle the dragon's breath while it still falls, then defeat the Ender Dragon. Plain words leave more room for careful choices.
The Last Ember is not ready to ask this of you right now.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bottle 1 dragon breath while the dragon is alive, then defeat the Ender Dragon.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: The roar has ended. Bring end stone so the village can set something solid beside the bottled breath.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bring 16 end stone so the lesson has something solid under it.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Proof is heavy in stranger ways than stone.
Bring 16 end stone now that the dragon is defeated; the bottled breath is already accounted for.
The proof can wait until the dragon has fallen.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bring 16 end stone to complete the proof.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: You are here. That is the first proof. The rest can go on the table.
The final note says this: the world can be vast, cruel, and still return someone home. The village will remember that without making it smaller.
The Last Ember still needs its proof.
Bring the dragon breath and end stone here before we finish the notes.
I cannot close the Last Ember right now.
The last page waits. It has earned patience.
messages.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Return with the Last Ember proof.
